resources.string: "Turn it on in Settings → Security so the app asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN every time you open it."
"Add items by typing, dictating or scanning the barcode. The list is sorted by category and by the aisles of your supermarket."
"Add a single recipe to one of your books"
"Add steps for a sub-recipe (e.g. a sauce)"
"Point at the Miga invitation QR code"
"Point at the Miga list QR code"
"The downloaded file isn't a valid ZIP"
"Drag the corners to adjust the crop."
"So everyone knows who added or ticked each item."
"Photos are still being processed. Any that haven't finished won't be saved."
"You don't have any templates yet. Create one and fill it with Open Food Facts products (bookmark icon in Products) or save the current list."
"You don't have any recipes yet.\nAdd some to start seeing statistics."
"You don't have any recipes yet.\nTap \"New recipe\" to add the first one."
"This book has %1$s recipes. Move or delete them before deleting the book."
"This book has 1 recipe. Move or delete it before deleting the book."
"Delete \"%1$s\"? The items in your list won't change."
"Look for typical dishes from a region or country, or describe what you feel like cooking; the AI will suggest several ideas to choose from."

"Each book is someone's recipe collection (for example your mum's, a friend's or one per theme), with its own cover. When a book is open, new recipes are saved there by default. You can move a recipe to another book from its options menu (⋮)."
"Each supermarket keeps its own aisle order: pick one and the list is sorted the way you walk through it."
"Connect the app to one or more namespaces on a self-hosted server to share and sync read-write books and recipes with other Miga apps."
"Unencrypted connection (http) outside your local network: your token and data would travel unprotected over the internet. Use https:// or a VPN."
"Set up a %1$s API key in Settings"
"Set up a fingerprint, face or PIN on your device to turn on the lock"
"Set up an AI provider in Settings to use this."
"Set up an AI provider in Settings to use search."
"Set up an AI provider in Settings to see this."
"Create a book for each person or theme (grandma's, desserts, quick dinners…) and fill it with recipes."
"Tell us what's wrong. The generated text will be sent with your report so it can be reviewed."
"Collaborative data from Open Food Facts: always check the label on the pack."
"Data from Open Food Facts (ODbL licence), an open, collaborative database."

"From a book's menu, \"Add from photo\" reads the text in a photo (camera or gallery) with AI and fills in the editor so you only have to review it before saving. It needs an internet connection and your own AI API key, set in Settings → Artificial intelligence; without it no photo is sent anywhere."
"In a recipe with steps, tap \"Cooking mode\" to see them full screen, one by one, without the screen turning off while you cook."
"You can export a recipe as text, PDF or JSON, or a whole book from its menu. And from Settings you can create or restore a full backup."
"You can then add Open Food Facts products to it, scanned or typed."
"To edit the same list with other people, share it from Settings → Sync."
"Scan the QR code of another Miga list"
"Type or dictate what you need above, or start here:"
"Type or paste one item per line, or separate them with commas. You can include quantity and unit: \"2 kg tomatoes\"."
"Type a product and tap search. The most scanned ones come first."
"Type a product and tap search. ⊕ adds it to the list; the bookmark saves it to a template for next time."
"When you type an ingredient name in a recipe, the app suggests the ones you've used before so you don't have to type them again."
"That QR code isn't a Miga list"
"That QR code isn't a Miga invitation"
"This book is an installed pack and is read-only. You can view and cook its recipes, but not change its name, cover or content. You can only uninstall it."
"This book is installed as read-only: you can view it, cook and export its recipes, but not edit them. It will update when the author publishes a new version."
"This pack is no longer in the catalogue"
"No duration was detected in this step"
"This server doesn't support invitations: update miga-server"
"Miga's own estimate based on Open Food Facts data: 60% nutritional quality, 30% additives and 10% organic. It's a guide only and doesn't replace advice from a health professional."
"This is what was saved from the last crash, only on this device. You can copy or share it to report it, or just discard it."
"Saves books, recipes and photos in a ZIP file"
"Keep your family recipes in books, with photos, sub-recipes, adjustable servings and a step-by-step cooking mode."
"The %1$s items in the list (with their photos and details) are saved so you can add them again with one tap."
"Found a bug or have a suggestion? Write to us."
"Language used to recognise what you dictate (shopping list, recipe steps and cooking mode). Voice commands in cooking mode work in Spanish and English."
"Install ready-to-use recipe books. They're read-only: you can browse, cook and uninstall them, but not edit them."
"Invite another app with a QR code"
"Miga will restart to apply the language."
"Which book do you want to add this recipe to?"
"The books it synced will become local; nothing is deleted, they just stop syncing."
"Capped at 49 because it contains a high-risk additive."
"The list is too big for a QR code. Use \"Send as text\"."

"No recipe was found in the photo"

"Couldn't download the pack. Check your connection and try again."

"No results. Try another name or remove the Spain filter."
"You don't have any other recipe books yet."
"You don't have any books. Create one first."
"By name, ingredient, tag, utensil or difficulty, across all your books at once."

"On the other phone: Settings → Sync → Manage connections → scan icon. Anyone who scans this code can read and change the content of this namespace, so only show it to people you trust. You can revoke access from the server."
"The pack doesn't include the book details"
"To send it to another phone with Miga"
"Paste a link to a recipe from any website and the AI will recognise it and fill in the editor."
"Asks for your device's fingerprint, face or PIN when opening the app"
"Empty template. Type items, search Open Food Facts or scan a barcode."
"Product not found in Open Food Facts (%1$s)"
"Product not found in Open Food Facts (%1$s). Type it in instead."
"Try other words or remove a filter."
"Does the recipe continue in another photo? You can keep adding pages or continue with the ones you have."
"Recipes are grouped by category in the list. You can add, rename or delete categories, utensils and ingredients from Settings → Manage."
"Recipes imported with AI from %1$s photos (review each recipe and report a specific one from its editor)."

"Reads the text in a photo of a recipe (book, magazine, handwritten) and rates how healthy it is, using the AI provider you choose. The photo or text is sent to that provider for processing; no copy is kept except what you choose to add to the recipe."
"Speech recognition isn't available on this device"
"Restore from a ZIP or JSON; you can delete your current data first"
"Are you sure you want to delete all the items in \"%1$s\"?"
"Are you sure you want to delete it? This can't be undone."
"Are you sure you want to uninstall \"%1$s\"? All its recipes will be removed from this device."
"Are you sure you want to delete \"%1$s\"? This can't be undone."
"Are you sure you want to delete %1$s recipes? This can't be undone."
"Your own server: books, recipes and shopping list"
"No accounts or ads. AI with your own key, Open Food Facts and syncing with your own server are all optional."
"Tap to add to or remove from the list"
"Tap the heart on a recipe to keep it handy here."
"You don't have any connections yet.\nAdd one to share and sync books with other Miga apps through your own server."
"%1$s items will be added to your list (quantities are added to what you already have):"

"%1$s recipe(s) will be imported. Do you want to delete your current books and recipes (with their photos) first for a clean start, or add the imported content to what you already have? Installed packs aren't affected."
"Voice used to read the steps aloud in cooking mode."
"%1$s items to buy. On the other phone: menu → Share… → Receive via QR."
"\"%1$s\" will be saved with its photo and details."

"Add an API key in Settings → Artificial intelligence to use other models."
"Turn it off to hide every AI feature: importing from photos or links, recipe search, health rating, nutrition and substitutes."
"Rates how healthy a recipe is from its ingredients when you open it."
"Estimates calories and macros per serving when you open a recipe."

"Add an AI provider key in Settings → Artificial intelligence."
"They're tried in this order: if one fails or can't read images, the next one is used. Drag ⠿ to change the priority. Only providers with a key are used."
"Free models have usage limits and can be slow or busy at times; if one fails, the next provider in the list is used."
